source_map.claim: PF_EXITING is bit0x4; PF_KTHREAD is a separate bit. These are task flags, not the task state or an exit-completion result.
exit_signals sets PF_EXITING for this task.
do_exit invokes exit_signals before exit_mm and invokes exit_notify much later. Other threads may still exist; group_dead is separately computed.
exit_mm clears current->mm under task_lock before mm_update_next_owner and mmput; memory teardown may still be executing.
mmput may invoke __mmput including exit_mmap; a detached task mm pointer is not proof that all memory has already been freed.
get_task_mm reads task->mm under task_lock and takes a reference when applicable; PF_KTHREAD is excluded.
proc_pid_status invokes task_mem only when get_task_mm returned a non-null mm.
task_mem emits VmRSS along with the other mm-backed memory fields.
Reported state derives from task __state and exit_state separately from PF_EXITING; R does not disprove exit-in-progress.

do_task_stat exports task flags as field9; with the current parser tail beginning at field3, flags is index6. RSS field24 has a zero fallback when mm is absent and must not be used as proof of measured zero RSS.
exit_notify sets EXIT_ZOMBIE/EXIT_DEAD after exit_mm and subsequent teardown.

proc_descriptor_documentation.claim: Held proc descriptors do not retarget a new process after PID reuse; operations on an exited task generally fail. Preserve identity comparisons rather than reopening numeric paths blindly.

findings: The source admits a real R plus missing VmRSS interval during exit: mm detaches before exit_state becomes zombie/dead. This is source-supported possibility, not proof of the actual run.
PF_EXITING observed for the same held task identity distinguishes kernel exit-in-progress from a task with no such evidence. It is set before exit_mm and does not alone prove mm detachment.
Even PF_EXITING plus an intact status missing all mm-backed fields does not certify zero remaining resident memory: mmput/exit_mmap can run after task->mm becomes NULL.
A task flag is not group completion. A leader may be exiting while another thread or descendant remains live; all owned group members must retain supervision.
Current three observations contain neither flags nor raw status. Their repeated hash cannot reveal the missing bytes. No retrospective kernel-attested classification is possible from this record.
The actual run stays failed. Ownership report success and three unchanged Shorts are separate from resource-supervision acceptance.

minimal_algorithm.policy: Typed observations plus terminal-only reconciliation; PF_EXITING is diagnostic, never an RSS value or acceptance override.
steps: At each existing attempt preserve exact owned-task stat/status bytes or bounded counter-only raw lines with byte hashes; keep PID,pgrp,starttime,State,flags,PF_EXITING,PF_KTHREAD and before/after identity. Do not read argv or environment.
For identity-matched complete decimal VmRSS use the original numeric parsing and RSS/available-memory gates. PF_EXITING never bypasses a present RSS counter.

For a missing counter retain a typed MissingRSS evidence record. If matching before/after flags contain PF_EXITING, label exit_in_progress_counter_unavailable; otherwise label live_or_unknown_counter_unavailable. Both remain unmeasured, not zero or a reused sample.
Keep the original three attempts,20ms intervals and100ms total deadline. Malformed counters, permissions, missing MemAvailable, PID/starttime changes and unknown state fail closed.

Only at the supervisor exception boundary, before sending cleanup signals, reconcile a typed missing-RSS error if Popen.poll already confirms completion and identity-aware inspection confirms no live owned group member or PID reuse. Preserve the error and terminal evidence separately; do not report a fresh RSS sample.
Keep the child returncode and exact streams, normal passed=True requirement, orphan refusal and cleanup unchanged. A completed nonzero process still fails its original gate.
If a task is still live or termination/ownership is uncertain, retain failure even when PF_EXITING is set. Do not classify the existing run as successful.
minimal_algorithm.bounded_optional_variant: A separately reviewed terminal-only reconciliation may consume unused time within the SAME100ms snapshot deadline, without a fourth RSS sample, resetting a deadline, or exceeding the original command limit. It must still end with confirmed parent completion and no live group. This timing refinement is not implemented or qualified and is not assumed to repair the observed run.
